description: Glass camera view as of 2026-11-20 morning (re-derived from scratch on a 10-min recording, live_20261120_view3.mp4). Vertical count line at x=0.50, between the two free-standing sign boards (x~0.46-0.48 and 0.54-0.56): at 0.55 the right board hid people walking along the far edge and caused misses. Foot ROI follows the plaza's far edge on the left and the stair edge along the glass railing on the right; everything above it (people seen through / reflected in the glass, which produced a dense band of detections) is excluded. Only right-to-left passages are counted. late_birth_crossings counts people first detected just past the line after crossing hidden in a group or under a reflection streak. With it, rtl was 133-135 for line_x 0.50-0.60 on the 10-min clip; every event that differed between positions was checked by eye and 0.50 counted all of them once. If the sign boards are moved, re-check the line position. stitch_crossings (2026-11-20 11:40): a track broken while people overlap at the line is joined with its continuation past the line, or counted when it vanishes at the line moving across (biased to over-count); duplicate detection is scaled to person size so companions walking side by side are not merged.
